$comment: Machine-readable mirror of docs/data/sources.md's Licence position / Status columns. This is what 01_fetch.sh actually reads to decide whether a real fetch may run — the prose document is the record of *why*, this file is what the pipeline checks before touching a network. The two must be kept in sync by hand: whenever a row in docs/data/sources.md changes status, update the matching entry here in the same change. A `fetch` block is the pinned artefact from that row's 'Pinned artefacts' line; 01_fetch.sh verifies what the server returns against `pinned*` before writing anything, so a silently re-issued file fails loudly instead of changing sela's inputs.

bfn-schutzgebiete.blockedBy: geodienste.bfn.de returned HTTP 403 on every path on 2026-09-18; no extract could be pinned. Licence (GeoNutzV) is cleared — see docs/data/sources.md §2.1.

osm-geofabrik.note: Withdrawn by ADR-0005 (2026-09-19), not merely unconfirmed. OSM's licence is fine; the ODbL share-alike term would attach to sela's own scoring database wherever OSM-derived rows enter criterion_value. Both uses now have licence-clean substitutes: basemap.de (CC BY 4.0) for the basemap, BKG CLC5 classes 111/112 (dl-de/by-2-0) for settlement geometry. Re-confirming this source means reopening ADR-0005.

fetch.$comment: The full published series is fetched because *which* years feed pv_irradiation_annual (a single year, a rolling mean, the 1991-2020 normal) is an open scoring decision under CLAUDE.md §3 — see docs/data/sources.md §5.1. Fetching everything keeps that decision open instead of pre-empting it. lastYear is extended by DWD around February each year.

aggregation.$comment: Decided 2026-09-19 (docs/data/sources.md §5.2). A single annual grid is a weather observation, not a site property: interannual sd is 4.7% of the mean. The WMO 1991-2020 normal removes that noise but introduces a worse error — global radiation over Germany trends +3.35 kWh/m2/yr across this record, so the normal sits 5.4% BELOW the last decade, a bias as large as DWD's own +/-6% method uncertainty. A 10-year trailing mean keeps the sampling term at ~1.5% while tracking the trend. Roll the window forward when DWD publishes a new year; changing windowYears is a CLAUDE.md §3 scoring decision.

fetch.$comment: Supplies the pilot region boundary (docs/architecture/roadmap-to-first-deployment.md §2.3). UTM32S matches the EPSG:25832 storage CRS, so no reprojection. Only layer vg25_krs, AGS 12073 (Landkreis Uckermark) is used; the rest of the federal coverage is fetched but not ingested. Licence read from nutzungsbedingungen_vg25.pdf inside the archive itself — it is CC BY 4.0, NOT dl-de/by-2-0 like BKG's CLC5.
